description: Supervisor Solis and the LA County Board of Supervisors voted and approved for a pilot program aimed to provide a guaranteed income of $1,204 a month to young adults in Los Angeles County. The program, approved unanimously by the L.A. County Board of Supervisors will provide the payments for three years to 150 residents ages
